name: FableVision
description: Finds seeds for NEW worlds, and only on the Create World screen. Describe the spawn you want, like a village next to a cherry grove or a mansion in a dark forest, or pick from a list. It tests real seeds with the game's own world generation until one matches, fills in the seed, and shows it on a map before you press Create. It cannot read a server's seed or search an existing world. Typing a wish needs no AI key for common wishes; with your own key it can read any wish. The vision settings, food HUD, G-key AI panel and Bedrock LAN tip are in the separate FableVision Extras mod.
